WITH RECURSIVE explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct children of set 71827-1 from current inventory
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_num,
        c.color_id,
        c.qty,
        c.is_spare
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'set' 
      AND c.parent_num = '71827-1'
      AND c.version = (
          SELECT MAX(version) 
          FROM u_composition 
          WHERE parent_kind = 'set' AND parent_num = '71827-1'
      )
      AND (c.child_kind != 'part' OR c.is_spare = FALSE)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: explode nested sets and minifigs
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_num,
        c.color_id,
        e.qty * c.qty AS qty,
        c.is_spare
    FROM explosion e
    JOIN u_composition c ON 
        (e.child_kind = 'set' AND c.parent_kind = 'set' AND c.parent_num = e.child_num)
        OR (e.child_kind = 'minifig' AND c.parent_kind = 'minifig' AND c.parent_num = e.child_num)

        SELECT MAX(version) 
        FROM u_composition 
        WHERE parent_kind = c.parent_kind AND parent_num = c.parent_num
    )
    AND (c.child_kind != 'part' OR c.is_spare = FALSE)
)

WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all sets released in 2014
sets_2014 AS (
    SELECT set_num FROM sets WHERE year = 2014
),
-- Get current inventory version for each set in 2014
current_versions AS (
    SELECT 
        parent_num AS set_num,
        MAX(version) AS max_version
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'set'
      AND parent_num IN (SELECT set_num FROM sets_2014)
    GROUP BY parent_num
),
-- Recursive explosion: start from sets in 2014 with their current inventory
explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct children of 2014 sets from their current inventory
    SELECT 
        c.parent_num AS root_set,
        c.child_kind AS item_kind,
        c.child_num AS item_num,
        c.color_id,
        c.qty AS total_qty,
        c.is_spare
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN current_versions cv 
      ON c.parent_num = cv.set_num AND c.version = cv.max_version
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'set'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: expand sets and minifigs
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        c.child_kind AS item_kind,
        c.child_num AS item_num,
        CASE WHEN c.child_kind = 'part' THEN c.color_id ELSE NULL END AS color_id,
        e.total_qty * c.qty AS total_qty,
        CASE WHEN c.child_kind = 'part' THEN c.is_spare ELSE FALSE END AS is_spare
    FROM explosion e
    JOIN u_composition c 
      ON e.item_num = c.parent_num AND e.item_kind = c.parent_kind
    -- Get current version of the nested item's inventory
    JOIN (
        SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM u_composition
        GROUP BY parent_kind, parent_num
    ) cv ON c.parent_kind = cv.parent_kind 
        AND c.parent_num = cv.parent_num 
        AND c.version = cv.max_version
    WHERE e.item_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')
),
-- Get the color ID for Trans-Brown
trans_brown_color AS (
    SELECT id AS color_id FROM colors WHERE name = 'Trans-Brown'
)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.total_qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM explosion e
JOIN trans_brown_color tbc ON e.color_id = tbc.color_id
WHERE e.item_kind = 'part'
  AND e.item_num = '86500'
  AND e.is_spare = FALSE;
